body.p: This command sets and queries HTTP content information.
<id>: Mandatory parameter. Client instance created by the AT+HTTPCREATE command.
<content>: Optional parameter. Content information to be configured.
<encode_method>: Optional parameter. Specifies whether the format of the <content> parameter is escaped characters or hexadecimal ASCII code.
When the input content field is empty, all previously configured content shall be cleared.
When the input content field is not empty, the newly input content shall be appended after the previously configured content.

entry.p: // Example 1: Add content information to the HTTP instance with ID 0. The input encoding is hexadecimal ASCII
// Example 2: Append content information to the HTTP instance with ID 0. The input encoding is escaped characters
